description:
workflows/contractenrollment — POST /traeger/contract-enrollments/ (#7760, ADR 0309 section 4) that enrolls
one child without a coming pickup exception and binds its contract: the statements of the preview (with the hold of the school
as one of the Träger), the
silent enrollment under the approval gates and the binding in a second Träger transaction. The workflow
and Enrollment's own statements stay flat as children grow; Care Plan's per-child building blocks of an
approval add an exact residual the test asserts (20 per child here, ADR 0309 section 2).
